about_the_game:
Manage an illegal business, get rid of undercover cops with the mafia’s help, and ultimately buy your apartment to become fully independent.

TOMATO IS BANNED

Tomatoes are illegal globally. But, just like most of the plants, it can be grown easily on most places, like a balcony. You are working on a tomato shop. Daily,

  • Grow tomato plants

  • Talk with plants to improve productivity

  • Dump spoiled tomatoes to decrease spreading smell

  • Dry harvested tomatoes to sell

Tomatoes smell and the lady living across the hall seems like an retired cop. So, be careful when opening apartment door.

CUSTOMERS

The shop is near an university and most of the customers are students. But, there are some undercover policeman hidden as students as well. At least, they follow rules.

Every time you open the shop, mafia gives information about their current rules and trends. They can be deducted from regular customers when you know their patterns.

When you detect an undercover cop and notify mafia, they take care of them. 

MAFIA

Help is not free. you need to pay protection money to mafia.

content_descriptors.notes: Even though tomatoes are legal, in the game it is banned. So, growing or selling those can be perceived as "dealing".
